title: Calendar
lead: The calendar control lets people select and view a single date or a range of dates in their calendar. It’s made up of 3 separate views: the month view, year view, and decade view.

examples.name: Calendar Month Only
examples.description: A Calendar Compat allows you to only show the month and year picker leaving the day picker hidden.

examples.name: Calendar Overlaid Month
examples.description: A Calendar Compat allows you to render the month picker over the day picker. This is useful when there are width constraints and the month picker is needed.

examples.name: Calendar Date Boundaries
examples.description: A Calendar Compat can be modified to set a minDate and maxDate in order to restrict the dates that can be selected.

examples.name: Calendar Six Weeks
examples.description: A Calendar Compat allows you to set a six week month.

examples.name: Calendar Week Numbers
examples.description: A Calendar Compat allows you to show the week numbers next to the day grid for their respective week.

examples.name: Calendar Week Selection
examples.description: A Calendar Compat allows you to set a selection range of weeks instead of selecting a single day.

examples.name: Calendar Marked Days
examples.description: A Calendar Compat allows you to pass a callback that returns an array of number that should bemarked. This callback provides a starting date and an ending date.

examples.name: Calendar Month Selection
examples.description: A Calendar Compat allows you to set a selection range of months instead of selecting a single day.

examples.name: Calendar Multiday Day View
examples.description: A Calendar Compat allows you to pass a number of days that will be highlighted from the selected date and forward.

examples.name: Calendar Contiguous Work Week Days
examples.description: A Calendar Compat can be modified to allow selecting a contiguous (5 day) work week.

examples.name: Calendar Non Contiguous Work Week Days
examples.description: A Calendar Compat can be modified to allow selecting a non contiguous (7 day) week.

examples.name: Calendar Custom Day Cell Ref
examples.description: A Calendar Compat can be modified to allow selecting a non contiguous (7 day) week.

prose.text:
## Best practices

### Layout

- Don’t break the control apart.
- Include up and down arrow buttons for navigating between time ranges and a chevron to make the calendar collapsible.

### Content

- Use the following format for dates: month, day, year, as in July 31, 2016. When space is limited, use numbers and slashes for dates if the code supports that format and automatically displays the appropriate date format for different locales. For example, 2/16/19.
- Don't use ordinal numbers (such as 1st, 12th, or 23rd) to indicate a date.
- The control provides English strings by default. For localized apps, you must override these using the strings prop.
